text_block_list.text: With that said, Kawakami Princess slumps onto the turf, looking as if she's melting into it.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
This year's Oka Sho was amazing~!
So these girls are the stars of this year's Tiara route~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, did any girl catch your eye already?
As for me—"

The crowd's excitement was unlike anything before.
The sensation of being watched. A once-in-a-lifetime stage.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
how did today's race look to you...?"
Even so, she never let the immediate goal of victory blind her—she kept facing her own challenges head-on.
—I'm sure if it's her, she'll be fine now.
